en: Oh, and I should mention...

You have a history with one of the
organizations that's crept into Kamurocho.
A Korean gang, the Jingweon Mafia.
The Jingweon...

Both times they expanded into Kamurocho,
they were obliterated by the Tojo Clan.

The first time was over thirty years ago,
and the second was just a decade back.

I'm told you played a large role in
crushing them with the Tojo Clan.
That was ages ago.

It may be to you, but they remember
their grudges, both with you and the Tojo.

If you plan on staying in Kamurocho,
I suggest you watch your back.

(What was Haruka doing here?
And with her child, no less...)
(Not many cars come down this street.)

(I bet there are still some clues
related to the incident around here.)

(Apparently the culprit's car came
speeding out of that parking garage.)
(The gate got torn down in the process.)

(He must have already been going
pretty fast by the time he reached it...)
(Tire tracks?)

(The car was probably swerving down
the road as he tried to regain control.)
(But why was the driver being so reckless?)
(Was he really just panicked?)

(Blood spatters... This must be where
Haruka was hit by the car.)

That's where Haruka Sawamura was
walking when the car came.

She tried to get out of the way once
she noticed, but there was no escape.

All she could do was wrap herself
around the child to keep him safe.

Look around you, though.
There are skid marks all over the road.

After he hit Haruka, the driver tried to
stop, but then he second-guessed it.
He must have been in quite a hurry.

He didn't even stop to check if the
young woman he'd hit was alive.
So? What are you getting at?

Let's think about this. Assuming the driver
went after Haruka to get revenge on you...

...Wouldn't he need to check whether
or not she was still alive afterward?

But in this case, the culprit didn't do
that. There can only be one reason.

Your history as a yakuza had nothing
to do with why she was hit.
It was just an unfortunate accident.

She was in the wrong place at the wrong
time. You should put your mind at ease.

But that punk driver...
He's still out there, isn't he?

Is it really that easy for a common thug
to escape from the law these days?

The police are making a concerted effort
to find him. It's too early to say "escaped."

By the way, perhaps you
haven't noticed...
...But you're being watched.

That guy in the hat?
How long has he been there?

I only just spotted him, but he's
certainly trying to record you.

The guy on the motorcycle?
How long has he been there?
What'll you do?

Is he keeping tabs on me?
Or is he here to see the crime scene?

Just wanna have a chat. If he's interested
in me, I should give him a personal intro.

Yeah, I'm there now.
Everything's going smoothly.
What are you up to here?
...Shit!
Hey, I sait wait!
Damn, where'd he go!?
Stop!
Dammit!
Give up!

Who the hell are you?
And why were you spying on me?

I-I wasn't spying on you, I swear!
I was protecting you.
Wait, you're Tojo Clan?

Yes. I'm from the Someya Family,
one of the Tojo Clan subsidiaries.

Please forgive me, Fourth Chairman!
My boss ordered me to!

He wanted me to stay in the shadows
to make sure you stay safe.

But I just got to Kamurocho today, and no
one from the Tojo Clan knew I was coming.

This doesn't make any sense.
How did they know I'd be here?

I'm not really sure myself.
I was just following orders, sir.

He said if I waited by that alley,
you would show up.

He also told me someone very
important to you was in an accident.
My boss seems to know a lot about you.

So he does. And where exactly is
this boss of yours now?

Where can I meet with the
patriarch of the Someya Family?

I have contacts who can
tell me if you won't.
But I'd rather save us both some time.
If you insist. My boss...

He's at Tojo Headquarters. He said he had
a meeting with Acting Chairman Sugai.

Tojo Headquarters... Damn it, I never
wanted to set foot in there again.
Um, is something wrong?

I just spent three years in prison to
wash off the stench of the Tojo Clan.

I've only been out for a few days,
and I'm already getting pulled back in...

(What does the Someya Family patriarch
know about me and Haruka's accident?)

(Looks like my answers are at Tojo Clan
Headquarters. I should find a taxi...)

(After all that, I still don't have any leads.
Can I really count on the police to find this guy?)

(Maybe I should head back to New Serena
in case there's been any updates...)

I heard from Date-san earlier.
He said Haruka-chan was in an accident?

Yeah. As we speak, she's in
critical condition in the ICU.

They haven't found the guy who did it yet,
either.

I'm trying to find out what I can on my own, too.
No luck yet, though.

Kiryu-san.
You have a smartphone, right?
I do.
Can I see it for a sec?
There, that should do it.
Hm? What did you do?

I installed an app that serves as a
sort of bulletin board for Kamurocho.

I'm not sure, but you might be
able to find some info there.

Thanks for that, Mama.
I'll look at it later.

Yeah, it's me. Akiyama's here
with me at the hospital now.

You should come back if you can.
I need to head out for a bit.
Okay, I'll be right there.

Akiyama. Hm?
What's this? You got cleaned up.

Yeah, well... I kept getting turned
away at the door in those rags.

Date-san told me everything, though.
Haruka-chan's still in the ICU.
She's still unresponsive.

One more thing, Kiryu-san.
It's about Haruka-chan's kid.

There's a guy here from Child Services.
Says he wants to talk to you, Kiryu-san.

You're Haruka Sawamura's associate, yes?
I'm Nojiri from Child Protection Services.

I received a call earlier today asking me
to retrieve her child from this hospital.

As Sawamura-san has no living relatives,
we will be taking custody of the child.

This is just standard procedure in these
cases. Sorry, but if you'll excuse me...

Is Haruka's son going to
end up in an orphanage?

Yes, though considering he's not even a
year old, he'll go to a nursery first.

Regardless, he must be taken in until
Sawamura-san can fully recover.

Hold on a second. I'm Haruka Sawamura's
guardian. The name's Kiryu.

I can take responsibility for her child.
You guys don't need to get involved.

You claim to be her guardian,
yet you're not related to her?

Therefore you're a self-proclaimed guardian
who has no legal claim to the child.

Imagine. What if you were only saying
that to harvest the baby's organs or something?
The hell?

Sorry, I suppose that was
a bit of an exaggeration.

But if we did hand the child over to you,
the liability would fall directly on us.

Nowadays when a parent beats their child
to death, the public blames our agency.

People simply choose to ignore the fact
that we're understaffed and overworked.

If anything were to happen to the child
under your care, we would take the fall.
Please try to understand my position.
Look. It's Nojiri-san, right?

Is everyone in Child Protection Services
a bastard like you? Couldn't be, right?
Pardon?

You don't even care about the kids.
All that matters to you is your position.
Haruka and I were raised in an orphanage.

If you grew up with parents watching over you,
you'll never know how painful that can be.

So listen up. I won't let you send a kid
who can't even talk to a place like that.

Haruka would say the same
thing if she were conscious.

Talk all you want,
but it doesn't change facts.

If you're not a direct relative, you have
no sway over what happens to this child.

The police never should have called you
here. You're just interfering.

Now then, I need to go speak to
a hospital representative.
Kiryu-san, where you going?

I'm not letting them take
Haruka's child away from her.

What? Hey, Kiryu-san!
Chill out a minute!

Man... I just can't bring myself
to fight you for real.
Got my ass kicked for nothing.
I'm sorry, Akiyama.

Is taking the kid really the only way?
We're all kinda screwed, you know.

I know I act before I think sometimes.
Call it a bad habit of mine.

Such a you answer. Guess that's why
you're the one and only Kazuma Kiryu.
There, there. That's it.

Don't drop him.
Easy now, be gentle.
Oh, please.

Remember Nojiri
from Child Protective Services?
I convinced him to let you take the kid.

Told him I'd take the fall for anything
that might happen under your care.
You did that for me?

Want to know what he said next?
"Take him for all I care."

Said he'd forget about the whole
hospital incident with you, too.

Bastard doesn't give a damn about
kids long as they're not on his list.

Hopefully guys like him are
an exception to the rule.

He's probably got a lot on his plate
with Child Services so understaffed.

Apparently he's requested a transfer.
They oughta grant it, for the kids' sake.

Not to mention the pride of everyone
with any pride working at the agency.
I'm sorry for all of this, Date-san.

It's nothing. I was pretty worried about
Haruka's kid getting taken away myself.
He reminds me of Saya at that age.

She's all grown up now, though.
In control of her own life.

Saya... Has it really been ten years since
she got caught up in that host scam?

Yeah. Hands down one of the
darkest moments of my life.

If you hadn't been there to help us out,
both Saya and I would be goners.

You know Kiryu, it feels like I still
haven't thanked you for all you did for us.

Then drinks are on you tonight, Date-san?
That would make a 10-year-old debt even.
Hell no, it wouldn't even come close.

This is kinda hard to say,
but I've got some news for you.
About Haruka.

So it seems.
After that...

...She decided to come back to Kamurocho
and got in the accident with her son today.

I can't say for sure, but it's likely Haruka
spent those years in Hiroshima.
Haruto's father is in Hiroshima then?

He may know what Haruka's been up to.
And why she was in Kamurocho.
I bet he could tell you everything.
So... What's next, Kiryu?

Let's just say I have a lot of questions
for this guy when I find him. But first...

...I'll teach him a lesson about being
around for the birth of a child.

He's going to learn how a real father
takes care of his children.

I'll leave for Hiroshima tomorrow,
with Haruto.
I'm not sure that's the best idea.
Hiroshima is home to the Yomei Alliance.
The Yomei Alliance...

After the Omi and the Tojo, they're
easily the third strongest clan in Japan.

They've never allied before, which keeps
them neutral. They're not hostile, either.

That might sound downright agreeable,
but that doesn't mean you want to test them.
They don't exactly take kindly to intruders.

The Omi Alliance tried, but not even
they could push into Yomei turf.

Yeah, I was always told to stay out of
Hiroshima. Nobody ever said why, though.

The Yomei Alliance practically
operates like a medieval shogunate.

Instead of focusing on expansion,
Chairman Kurusu fortified his own turf.
Takeru Kurusu...

I'm sure the name rings a few bells,
considering the world you left behind.

He was a famous gambler after the war,
and some would call him a living legend.

Right, but... I never heard of anyone who
actually met him during my Tojo days.

Seeing as the Yomei cut off communication to
the outside, we have almost nothing on them.

Even the police haven't heard the name
Takeru Kurusu since the mid 70s.

So what you're telling me is that you
guys don't know if he's even still alive?
If he is, he'd be pushing 100 by now.

Hardly likely a guy with one foot in the
grave could keep a whole clan in check, right?

Well according to a rumor,
Takeru Kurusu actually died years ago.

In his place, a captain named Koshimizu has
been pulling the strings behind the scenes.

Long story short, not even the cops can say
what's going on in the shadows of Hiroshima.

Exactly. And that's why you of
all people should steer clear.

One wrong move, and you could spark
a war between the Tojo and the Yomei.

I'm just a civilian now.
I don't have that kind of influence anymore.

Yeah, well, that's what I figured
you'd say anyway.

Date-san. While I'm away from Tokyo,
I need you to watch over Haruka.

Yeah, I'll make sure she's okay.
Akiyama would probably pitch in too.

I have to say, Haruka's kid
turned out pretty damn cute.

She probably knows better than anyone
that this is no time to be unconscious.
I know Haruka's going to wake up.

And when she does, Kiryu, you better
have Haruto's father here to see it happen.
(This is the town where Haruka's picture was taken.)
